description: MongoRescue: backups, RPO, restores, verification, PITR, copies, storage, HA and API rate limits. Runbooks: https://yigitcittan.github.io/mongorescue/runbooks/

links.tooltip: What to do when an alert fires

links.title: SLOs and sizing
links.tooltip: Suggested SLOs and the sizing guide

panels.title: Instances scraped
panels.description: Targets exposing mongorescue_build_info.

panels.title: Active instances (HA)
panels.description: 1 is healthy in an HA cluster. 0 means no active instance (MongoRescueHANoActiveInstance); it is also 0 outside HA mode.

panels.title: Scheduler tick age
panels.description: Seconds since the scheduler's last liveness tick. More than 90 means it is hung (MongoRescueSchedulerStale).

panels.title: RPO breaches
panels.description: Databases past their job's recovery point objective right now.

panels.title: Firing MongoRescue alerts
panels.description: Needs Prometheus to expose ALERTS (it does for its own rules). Each alert has a runbook in the docs.

panels.title: RPO compliance (range)
panels.description: Share of the selected time range in which databases met their RPO. Suggested SLO: 99.5% over 30 days.

panels.title: Backup success (range)
panels.description: Job runs that ended ok over runs that ended ok, partial or failed. Suggested SLO: 99%.

panels.title: Restore-test success (range)
panels.description: Restore tests that ended ok over all of them. Suggested SLO: 95%.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Version of the instances scraped.

panels.title: Backups by outcome
panels.description: Finished backups per database, by status.

panels.title: Job runs by outcome
panels.description: Finished job runs over all their databases; skipped runs are outside the backup window.

panels.title: Backup throughput (size / duration p50)
panels.description: An estimate: the size of the last archive over the median duration.

panels.title: Time since the last successful backup
panels.description: Per job and database, in seconds.

panels.title: RPO age vs target
panels.description: Age of the newest successful backup of each database against its objective.

panels.title: RPO met
panels.description: Green while the age is within the objective.

panels.title: Age as a share of the objective
panels.description: Above 100% the objective is missed.

panels.title: Verifications
panels.description: mismatch and error results fire MongoRescueVerificationFailed.

panels.title: Time since the last passed restore test
panels.description: Keep it below 8 days (the SLO of the production guide).

panels.title: PITR lag
panels.description: Newest write of the replica set minus the end of the last stored chunk. Alert above 15 minutes.

panels.title: Oplog headroom
panels.description: How long the collector may stop before oplog entries are lost.

panels.title: Time since the last stored chunk
Copy queue depth
panels.description: Alert when it is never empty for 4 hours.

panels.title: Local storage target free space
panels.description: Local storage targets only; S3 targets have no series.

panels.title: Days of space left (6h trend)
panels.description: Free bytes divided by the shrink rate of the last 6 hours (MongoRescueDiskFillingUp uses predict_linear over 24 hours).

panels.title: Missing archives
panels.description: Backup records whose archive the last storage scan did not find.

panels.title: Orphan archives
panels.description: Archives without a backup record found by the last scan.

panels.title: Time since the last storage scan
Time since the last metadata backup
Process memory and goroutines
panels.description: Compare with the container memory limit; see the sizing guide.

panels.title: Role
panels.description: Green while the instance is active, blue while standby.

panels.title: Lease epoch
panels.description: The fencing token; it grows with every takeover.

panels.title: Refusals
panels.description: Every non-zero line has a runbook.

panels.title: Refused snapshots on the HA target
API rate limits, notifications and keys
API requests refused (429)
panels.description: Requests refused by the REST rate limit; a steady line from one caller is a runaway script or a missing trusted proxy.

list.description: The MongoRescue job ID (label exported_job with Prometheus' default honor_labels: false; use job instead with honor_labels: true).
